description: This file defines a mock class for the IHealthcheckService interface used in unit testing. It includes mock methods for onPingSent, onAckReceived, and onServerRemoved, and is part of the rialto::servermanager::common namespace.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IHealthcheckService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Mock method to simulate the onPingSent event with serverId and pingId.

methods.name: onAckReceived

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Mock method to simulate server removal with serverId.
